issue: Brachialis and brachioradialis are the primary movers per EMG; vocabulary has no brachialis bucket so it is folded into biceps (Biceps Brachii) and brachioradialis into forearms (Wrist Extensors).

Quadratus lumborum is the true prime mover for lateral trunk flexion but has no allowed bucket/latin; mapped to Lower Back (Erector Spinae) as closest secondary. Single-side movement, but both obliques engage.
